verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents call the Stripe API and search its docs, and the Financial Connections use-case docs list agent-powered spending analysis and balance/transaction monitoring via Link CLI. That makes natural-language operation possible, but only indirectly through an external AI agent client. Nothing shows the MCP tools cover Financial Connections operations specifically. Missing for 10: confirmation that the MCP server exposes Financial Connections tools, any first-party natural-language interface, and hands-on or independent evidence of operating Financial Connections conversationally.
